upstream.description: Code, data and findings behind researchchamber.fun: experiments on open AI models with a pain pattern switched on

classification.analysis: Code, data and findings behind researchchamber.fun: experiments that steer open LLMs (Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Phi) with a pain-associated activation direction and test whether this changes their choices, such as paying a cost to press a stop button. It includes 118k saved test transcripts, steering vectors, LoRA fine-tune scripts, a games arena and a live Saw Test server. Based on the Pain Axis paper and its code. For interpretability and AI welfare researchers who want to reproduce or audit the numbers; very new and low-star.

use_cases.title: Reproduce a steering-vector behavioral experiment on open LLMs
Reuse saved transcripts and steering vectors as a research dataset
Copy the harness for running many seeded LLM trials with a database
